metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy tried to walk through my bullets by mistake LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did they just invite me to shoot at them?
I was definitely not ready but hey, I’ll take it!
Click if your kills come from pure enemy confusion!

Tap if your aim’s trash but the game still gives you gifts!
